_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Asking Krate how the build went

description: The state of a Krate build, by its build id: still building, failed, or published. A failed build's answer has Krate's check in its own words: the stage, what went wrong and how to fix it. A published build's answer has the app's link and a browser link that opens it on any device, nothing to install. Needs the person to sign in to Krate.

build_id.description: The build id a build answered with

name: build_status

browser_link.description: Opens the app in a browser on any device, nothing to install

detail.description: What went wrong, in the check's own words

fix.description: How to fix it, in the check's own words

link.description: The app's own link; it opens the newest version

stage.description: Where Krate's check stopped, on a failure

title: Check a Krate build
